meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或写了一半的小说导进写作项目,接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有完本或半成品小说,想放进统一流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import your finished or half-written novel into a project and keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or half-written novel and want to keep writing it in one flow.

howto.what: 把已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析成可续写的写作工程：项目目录（设定/大纲/正文/追踪）加拆文库分析资产；长篇、短篇按篇幅自动分流，分别复用对应的拆解管道完成分析。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-import，或说“导入小说”“反向解析”等关键词时触发；已有小说想接着往下写时也可用它。

say.text: 帮我导入《我的小说》，先确认是做成可续写工程还是只要拆文库
say.note: 会先问清目标再收集原文

say.text: 把 my-book.txt 按长篇导入，然后接着写第 120 章
say.note: 自动检测篇幅并复述请你确认

say.text: 我这本旧项目没有追踪文件，只重建追踪，别重拆全书
say.note: 只重建 追踪/，正文与设定不动

howto.what_en: Turns a novel you already wrote (half-finished or complete) into a writable project: project folders (settings/outline/manuscript/tracking) plus an analysis library. Long vs short is routed by length, each reusing its own analysis pipeline.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-import or phrases like "import novel" and "reverse-parse". Also useful when you have an existing book and want to continue writing it.

say_en.text: Import my novel; first ask if I want a writable project or just analysis
say_en.note: It asks the goal before collecting the source

say_en.text: Import my-book.txt as a long novel, then write chapter 120
say_en.note: It detects length and asks you to confirm

say_en.text: My old project has no tracking files; rebuild tracking only, no re-analysis
say_en.note: Only 追踪/ is rebuilt; text and settings stay
